name: HGNC_fetch_gene_by_symbol
description: Fetch detailed gene information from HGNC (HUGO Gene Nomenclature Committee) by official gene symbol. Returns comprehensive gene data including HGNC ID, full name, chromosomal location, cross-references to Ensembl, NCBI Entrez, UniProt, OMIM, and RefSeq. HGNC is the authoritative source for human gene nomenclature. A direct hit requires one unique upstream document whose returned symbol is verified case-insensitively before success (metadata.exact_identifier_verified). Example: 'TP53' returns tumor protein p53 with all its identifiers. Retired symbols are resolved automatically: if the symbol is not a current approved symbol, it is looked up as a previous symbol and then as an alias symbol, and the current gene's full record is returned with the substitution disclosed in metadata ('resolved_from', 'resolved_symbol', 'resolution_relation', 'symbol_resolution_note'). Example: 'CYP2E' returns CYP2E1 (renamed in 2002), 'DIA4' returns NQO1. If the retired symbol is ambiguous (shared by several genes) an error naming every candidate is returned instead of an arbitrary pick; if the symbol is unknown to HGNC entirely, metadata carries 'no_results_note' pointing at HGNC_search_genes.

locus_type.description: Type of locus (e.g., gene with protein product)

agr.description: Alliance of Genome Resources identifier, which for a human gene is its own HGNC id again, e.g. 'HGNC:11998'. Present on all 56 family members. Its use is as the key into AGR's cross-species orthology, not as new information about the gene.

alias_name.description: Previous or alternative FULL names of the gene (not symbols), e.g. ['Li-Fraumeni syndrome']. Present on 12 of 56 family members. alias_symbol carries the short forms.

cosmic.description: Gene symbol as COSMIC spells it, e.g. 'TP53'. Only 3 of 56 family members carry one, so its absence says nothing about whether the gene is mutated in cancer -- only that COSMIC's name differs or is unmapped.

date_approved_reserved.description: When the symbol was approved or reserved, ISO-8601 UTC, e.g. '1986-01-01T00:00:00Z'.

date_modified.description: When the HGNC record was last changed, e.g. '2023-01-20T00:00:00Z'.

date_name_changed.description: When the gene NAME last changed, e.g. '2018-04-23T00:00:00Z'. Null when it never has.

ena.description: INSDC/ENA nucleotide accessions for the gene, e.g. ['AF307851']. Present on 54 of 56.

gencc.description: GenCC identifier, which is the gene's own HGNC id, e.g. 'HGNC:11998'. Present on 18 of 56, and its presence is the signal that GenCC holds curated gene-disease validity assertions for this gene.

gene_group_id.description: Numeric HGNC gene-group ids the gene belongs to, e.g. [4068]. Parallel to gene_group, which gives the same groups by name; feed one of these to the family tool.

lsdb.description: Locus-specific mutation databases, one entry per database as 'Name|URL' in a SINGLE string, e.g. 'IARC TP53 Mutation Database|http://www-p53.iarc.fr/'. Split each entry on '|'. Present on 6 of 56.

mane_select.description: The MANE Select transcript, given as BOTH identifiers in one list: the Ensembl transcript with version and the matching RefSeq, e.g. ['ENST00000269305.9', 'NM_000546.6']. Present on 55 of 56. This is the single transcript NCBI and EMBL-EBI agreed to treat as the representative one, so it is the right default for anything that needs one transcript per gene.

mgd_id.description: Mouse Genome Database ids of the mouse orthologue(s), e.g. ['MGI:98834']. Present on all 56. A list because a human gene can have more than one mouse orthologue.

orphanet.description: Orphanet gene identifier as a NUMBER, e.g. 120204 -- not the 'ORPHA:' disease code. Present on 9 of 56.

pubmed_id.description: PubMed IDs behind the HGNC record, as NUMBERS not strings, e.g. [6396087, 3456488]. Present on 55 of 56.

rgd_id.description: Rat Genome Database ids of the rat orthologue(s), e.g. ['RGD:3889']. Present on 54 of 56.

ucsc_id.description: UCSC Genome Browser transcript id, e.g. 'uc060aur.1'.

uuid.description: HGNC's internal record UUID, e.g. 'cea1e056-2b30-44e1-88cd-65616aedd700'. Stable per record but not a citable gene identifier -- use hgnc_id for that.

vega_id.description: VEGA/Havana manually annotated gene id, e.g. 'OTTHUMG00000162125'.

name: HGNC_fetch_gene_by_id

name: HGNC_search_genes
description: Search HGNC by symbol, name, alias, previous symbol, external ID, or location. Wildcards are supported. The HGNC REST search endpoint returns its entire result set and ignores Solr-style rows/start controls (verified live: name=kinase returned 812/812); ToolUniverse therefore exposes no fake pagination and verifies len(docs)==numFound before reporting result_set_complete=true.

query.description: Search query - gene symbol, partial name, or keyword. Supports wildcards (*). Examples: 'BRCA*', 'tumor protein', 'insulin receptor'.

search_field.description: Field to search in. Options: 'symbol', 'name', 'alias_symbol', 'prev_symbol', 'entrez_id', 'ensembl_gene_id', 'uniprot_ids', 'location'. Default searches across symbol and name.

score.description: Relevance score for the hit, e.g. 40.0. An exact symbol match scores far above a partial one, so this is what separates them.

name: HGNC_search_by_location
description: Search HGNC for every gene mapped to a cytogenetic band. The upstream endpoint is unpaginated; the wrapper verifies returned count against numFound before marking the result set complete. Example: 17p13.1 includes TP53.

location.description: Cytogenetic band location. Examples: '17p13.1' (TP53 region), '17q21.31' (BRCA1 region), '7p11.2' (EGFR region), '13q14.2' (RB1 region).

score.description: Relevance score for the hit, e.g. 2.5478106. Results come back ordered by it.

name: HGNC_fetch_gene_family_members
description: Enumerate ALL member genes of an HGNC gene family/group by its numeric gene_group_id, returning the full HGNC record for every member gene. Unlike HGNC_fetch_gene_by_symbol/by_id (single gene) this lists the entire family. Each member record includes hgnc_id, approved symbol, full name, chromosomal location, locus type, and cross-references (Ensembl, Entrez, UniProt, OMIM, RefSeq). Example: gene_group_id '366' returns the 56 members of the 'Ubiquitin specific peptidases' family (USP1-USP54, USPL1, CYLD, PAN2). Find a gene_group_id from the 'gene_group_id' field of any gene record returned by HGNC_fetch_gene_by_symbol.

gene_group_id.description: Numeric HGNC gene group/family ID. Examples: '366' (Ubiquitin specific peptidases), '588' (BCL2 family), '475' (Solute carrier family). Accepts a string or integer.

oneOf.description: Full HGNC record for every member gene of the family
